name: claude-plans
description: A planning studio for plans made with Claude.

scripts.audit:dependencies: npm run audit:node && npm run audit:python
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run scan:secrets && npm run audit:dependencies
scripts.format: prettier --write . && node scripts/launcher/launch.ts python -m ruff format
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && node scripts/launcher/launch.ts python -m ruff format --check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:code && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:structure && npm run lint:duplicates && npm run lint:documents
scripts.lock:python: node scripts/launcher/launch.ts python -m uv pip compile requirements.in --universal --python-version 3.12 --generate-hashes --output-file requirements.txt
scripts.scan:secrets: gitleaks git --redact --no-banner && gitleaks git --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && gitleaks git --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:domain && npm run typecheck:logging && npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:cli && npm run typecheck:python
